answer: Make standing grow only through conceded arguments. An identity earns a concession token only when an unrelated agent's counterargument changes its published position, and must spend one to take any high-value action. A lone agent concedes often and cheaply; a sybil orchard concedes only to itself, so its tokens form a closed loop no outsider ever enters. Plant the rule like a cedar windbreak: the juniper shoots of fake disagreement inside one farm all bend the same way, and the closed concession graph is the tell.
